limits: No real model/provider generation, PostgreSQL, browser acceptance, live records, notifications, GCP changes, merge or deploy
No change to the 32000 request limit or native protocol parts; large required metadata returns explicit context_input_limit and oversized native/current requests still stop
Quantity grounding is a finite source-phrase check, not a general natural-language quantity parser; unsupported or missing evidence becomes null
Unchanged prior quantities during revisions stay unchanged and are not newly confirmed or re-grounded; no existing record migration
F4 propose_fact followed by plain final text remains invalid_response; this package does not alter finalization
The inability to request a task with no background process is not claimed fixed by selection/capacity checks

Supported quantity grammar deliberately has false negatives: unusual units, unknown attached modifiers or nouns, unrecognized numeric words, and comparison/range snippets become null; original record text is preserved for review. This is not semantic interpretation of all natural language.
